subject: Renewal: term uplift & inbound PO clearance (procurement portal steps)
messages:
From: Sam Ellis <sam.ellis@bluebridge.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-01T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal & capacity uplift question

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the briefing last week. We're finalizing our FY27 budget and would like to renew with Redwood for another 12 months but increase committed capacity by ~30% across embeddings + gen traffic. A couple of quick operational questions before I loop procurement:

- Can Redwood accept an inbound PO (we prefer to issue PO to your billing team) and what fields do you need on the PO?
- We need a short amendment to the existing MSA to reflect the term uplift and updated commit — do you have a standard SOW amendment we can sign via DocuSign?
- Is there a specific procurement portal workflow we should follow for evidence / SOC2 artifacts?

I've attached a one-page renewal summary with the requested new quantities. If you can point us at the quickest path (portal link, required docs, contact for billing), we'll expedite.

Attachments: BlueBridge_Renewal_Request.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Sam Ellis
Head of Procurement, BlueBridge Health
sam.ellis@bluebridge.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sam Ellis <sam.ellis@bluebridge.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity uplift question

Hi Sam — thanks, and great to hear you're moving forward. Short answers up front: yes, we can accept an inbound PO; we also provide a DocuSign amendment for the term/commit change. Recommended next steps below.

1) Inbound PO fields we need:
   - Redwood invoice name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Address + remit to instructions (we'll provide billing contact)
   - Purchase order number
   - Reference deal id: DL-2026-1298
   - Itemized line for committed tokens / embeddings units (optional, but helpful)

2) DocuSign amendment: we'll draft an SOW amendment that reflects the 12mo term + 30% uplift; that will be routed via DocuSign to the BlueBridge signatory.

3) Procurement portal and evidence: If your procurement team prefers the portal route, please upload the PO and SOC2 request form to Redwood’s procurement portal (link below). For evidence we're fine with redacted SOC2 report and an attestation letter. If you need a packaged evidence bundle, we can attach it to the DocuSign envelope or upload to the portal on your behalf (with your permission).

I've attached our renewal matrix template to speed up the PO line items. I'll loop in Jonas (billing & portal) and Marissa (customer success) to coordinate activation timeline once PO is received.

Attachments: redwood_renewal_matrix.xlsx

Redwood procurement portal: https://portal.redwood.ai/procure
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/tx/ABCD-2026-1298

Questions? If procurement wants a quick call to walk through fields, happy to set up a 15-min slot.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 650-555-2087

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-02T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity uplift question

Olga / Marissa — copying my notes here so we have an internal runbook for BlueBridge.

On Wed, Sep 1, 2026 at 11:02 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> I've attached our renewal matrix template to speed up the PO line items. I'll loop in Jonas (billing & portal) and Marissa (customer success) to coordinate activation timeline once PO is received.

Internal plan (high level):
- Step 1: Procurement uploads inbound PO to portal (we confirm match to matrix). If they send PO via email, billing will ingest and create an internal invoice record.
- Step 2: DocuSign SOW amendment drafted by ContractOps (I will own). We should include an explicit activation date tied to receipt of PO and cleared payment terms.
- Step 3: CS (Marissa) to trigger capacity ramp in Dedicated via the rollout playbook; expect 72-hour SLA for capacity activation post-PO clearance for standard commits.
- Step 4: If they require SOC2 artifacts, attach procurement_playbook_v2.pdf and share redacted report.

Marissa — can you confirm the 72-hour ramp SLA and whether we need finance sign-off for this level of uplift? Also flag if escalation to leadership is needed for any pricing concessions.

Attachments: procurement_playbook_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Billing & Partnerships
jonas.weber@redwood.com
